mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cps_initial_review_task WHERE issue_id = #{issueId} AND version_no = #{versionNo}
SELECT * FROM cps_initial_review_task WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND timeout_at <= #{now}
SELECT t.* FROM cps_initial_review_task t INNER JOIN cps_issue i ON i.id = t.issue_id WHERE i.status = 'PENDING_REVIEWER_CONFIG' AND t.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'TIMEOUT_OPEN')
mapper.update: UPDATE cps_initial_review_task SET status = 'TIMEOUT_OPEN', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE cps_initial_review_task SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, completed_at = #{now}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'TIMEOUT_OPEN')
UPDATE cps_initial_review_task SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{now}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'TIMEOUT_OPEN')

UPDATE cps_initial_review_task SET status = 'TAKEN_OVER', taken_over_by = #{takenOverBy}, taken_over_name = #{takenOverName}, taken_over_at = #{now}, takeover_reason = #{reason}, completed_at = #{now}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'TIMEOUT_OPEN', 'FAILED')
UPDATE cps_initial_review_task SET status = 'LATE_RESULT', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'TAKEN_OVER'
